theorem cone_no_antipodes (n : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1) {ξ : V}
    (hp : ξ∈cone n δ) (hm : -ξ∈cone n δ) : False
theorem zero_not_mem_cone (n : V) (δ : ℝ) : (0:V)∉cone n δ

theorem fourier_reality (f : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) (hr : ∀ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x)=f x) (ξ : V) :
    𝓕 f (-ξ)=starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 f ξ)

theorem real_schwartz_single_cone_zero (f : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) (n : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1)
    (hr : ∀ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x)=f x)
    (hsupp : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ cone n δ) : f=0

theorem real_vector_schwartz_single_cone_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (f : 𝓢(V, EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)) (n : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1)
    (hr : ∀ x i, starRingEnd ℂ (f x i)=f x i)
    (hsupp : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ cone n δ) : f=0

theorem even_density_half_integral (μ : Measure V) (hμ : MeasurePreserving Neg.neg μ μ)
    (a : V → ℝ) (hi : Integrable a μ) (hn : ∀ x, 0≤a x) (he : ∀ x, a (-x)=a x)
    (s : Set V) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hd : Disjoint s (Neg.neg ⁻¹' s)) :
    2*(∫ x in s, a x ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, a x ∂μ
theorem cone_measurable (n : V) (δ : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (SingleConeReality.cone n δ)

theorem density_integrable (c : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(V, EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)) (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (momentDensity c f k) volume

theorem density_even (c : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(V, EuclideanSpace ℂ ι))
    (hr : ∀ x i, starRingEnd ℂ (f x i)=f x i) (k : ℕ) (ξ : V) :
    momentDensity c f k (-ξ)=momentDensity c f k ξ

theorem cone_twice_le_total (c : ℝ) (hc : 0≤c) (f : 𝓢(V, EuclideanSpace ℂ ι))
    (hr : ∀ x i, starRingEnd ℂ (f x i)=f x i) (k : ℕ) (n : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1) :
    2*coneMoment c f k n δ ≤ SchwartzSpectralEnergies.spectralMoment c f k

theorem dominance_forces_half_error (c : ℝ) (hc : 0≤c) (f : 𝓢(V, EuclideanSpace ℂ ι))
    (hr : ∀ x i, starRingEnd ℂ (f x i)=f x i) (k : ℕ) (n : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1)
    (hE : 0<SchwartzSpectralEnergies.spectralMoment c f k) (ε : ℝ)
    (hdom : (1-ε)*SchwartzSpectralEnergies.spectralMoment c f k ≤ coneMoment c f k n δ) :
    (1:ℝ)/2≤ε

theorem projectedPhysicalField_norm_sq (c : ℝ) (hc : 0≤c) (f : 𝓢(V, EuclideanSpace ℂ ι))
    (k : ℕ) (s : Set V) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ‖projectedPhysicalField c hc f k s hs‖^2 = ∫ ξ in s, momentDensity c f k ξ

theorem real_cap_projection_half (c : ℝ) (hc : 0≤c) (f : 𝓢(V, EuclideanSpace ℂ ι))
    (hr : ∀ x i, starRingEnd ℂ (f x i)=f x i) (k : ℕ) (n : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1) :
    2*‖projectedPhysicalField c hc f k (SingleConeReality.cone n δ) (cone_measurable n δ)‖^2 ≤
      SchwartzSpectralEnergies.spectralMoment c f k

theorem bilinear_fourier_reflection (f g : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) :
    bilinearPairing f g = ∫ ξ : V, 𝓕 f ξ*𝓕 g (-ξ)

theorem scalar_hermitian_fourier (f g : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) :
    (∫ x : V, f x*starRingEnd ℂ (g x)) =
      ∫ ξ : V, 𝓕 f ξ*starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 g ξ)

theorem same_cone_bilinear_zero (f g : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) (n : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1)
    (hf : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ)
    (hg : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 g ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ) :
    bilinearPairing f g=0

theorem hermitian_self_positive (f : 𝓢(V, H)) (hf : f≠0) :
    0<(hermitianPairing f f).re

theorem same_cone_vector_bilinear_zero (f g : 𝓢(V, EuclideanSpace ℂ ι))
    (n : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1)
    (hf : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ)
    (hg : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 g ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ) :
    vectorBilinearPairing f g=0

theorem cone_mem_nhds (n : V) (hn : ‖n‖=1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) :
    SingleConeReality.cone n δ ∈ 𝓝 n

theorem exists_single_cone_schwartz_tsupport (n : V) (hn : ‖n‖=1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) :
    ∃ f : 𝓢(V, ℂ), 𝓕 f n=1 ∧ f≠0 ∧
      tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ

theorem exists_pairing_witness (n : V) (hn : ‖n‖=1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    ∃ f : 𝓢(V, ℂ), f≠0 ∧
      Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ ∧
      ¬(∀ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x)=f x) ∧
      SingleConePairings.bilinearPairing f f=0 ∧
      0<(SingleConePairings.hermitianPairing f f).re ∧
      SingleConePairings.bilinearPairing f f≠SingleConePairings.hermitianPairing f f

theorem fourier_partial (f : 𝓢(Space, ℂ)) (i : Fin 3) (ξ : Space) :
    𝓕 (∂_{axis i} f) ξ=kappa*(ξ i : ℂ)*𝓕 f ξ

theorem fourier_curl (f : 𝓢(Space, ℂ)) (ξ : Space) :
    𝓕 (curlField f) ξ =
      (kappa*(ξ 1 : ℂ)*𝓕 f ξ) • EuclideanSpace.single 0 (1:ℂ) +
        -((kappa*(ξ 0 : ℂ)*𝓕 f ξ) • EuclideanSpace.single 1 (1:ℂ))
theorem curl_divergence_zero (f : 𝓢(Space, ℂ)) : divergence (curlField f)=0

theorem curl_fourier_tsupport (f : 𝓢(Space, ℂ)) :
    tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 (curlField f) ξ) ⊆ tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ)

theorem exists_divergence_free_cone_witness (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    ∃ F : 𝓢(Space, Values), F≠0 ∧
      tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 F ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone (axis 0) δ ∧
      (∀ x, (∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Space => F y i) x (axis i))=0) ∧
      ¬(∀ x i, starRingEnd ℂ (F x i)=F x i) ∧
      SingleConePairings.vectorBilinearPairing F F=0 ∧
      0<(SingleConePairings.hermitianPairing F F).re

theorem fourier_product (f g : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) :
    𝓕 (product f g)=SchwartzMap.convolution (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ) (𝓕 f) (𝓕 g)

theorem convolution_integrand_integrable (f g : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) (ξ : V) :
    Integrable (fun η : V => 𝓕 f η*𝓕 g (ξ-η)) volume

theorem fourier_product_support (f g : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) :
    Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 (product f g) ξ) ⊆
      Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) + Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 g ξ)

theorem positive_product_support (f g : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) (n : V)
    (hf : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ positiveHalfspace n)
    (hg : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 g ξ) ⊆ positiveHalfspace n) :
    Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 (product f g) ξ) ⊆ positiveHalfspace n

theorem positive_triple_zero (f g h : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) (n : V)
    (hf : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ positiveHalfspace n)
    (hg : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 g ξ) ⊆ positiveHalfspace n)
    (hh : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 h ξ) ⊆ positiveHalfspace n) :
    (∫ x : V, f x*g x*h x)=0

theorem partial_fourier_support (f : 𝓢(Space, ℂ)) (i : Fin 3) :
    Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 (∂_{axis i} f) ξ) ⊆ Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ)

theorem cone_trilinear_zero (u v w : 𝓢(Space, Values)) (n : Space)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ≤1)
    (hu : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 u ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ)
    (hv : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 v ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ)
    (hw : Function.support (fun ξ => 𝓕 w ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone n δ) :
    trilinear u v w=0

theorem triadKernel_integrable (f g h : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) :
    Integrable (triadKernel f g h) ((volume : Measure V).prod volume)

theorem frequencyShear_preserving :
    MeasurePreserving (frequencyShear : V × V → V × V)
      ((volume : Measure V).prod volume) (volume.prod volume)

theorem convolutionKernel_integrable (f g h : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) :
    Integrable (convolutionKernel f g h) ((volume : Measure V).prod volume)

theorem scalar_fourier_representation_prod (f g h : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) :
    hermitianTriple f g h=∫ z : V × V, triadKernel f g h z ∂((volume : Measure V).prod volume)

theorem vectorKernel_integrable (u v w : 𝓢(Space, Values)) :
    Integrable (vectorKernel u v w) ((volume : Measure Space).prod volume)

theorem vector_fourier_representation_prod (u v w : 𝓢(Space, Values)) :
    hermitianTrilinear u v w=
      ∫ z : Space × Space, vectorKernel u v w z ∂((volume : Measure Space).prod volume)
theorem spectralBump_nonempty (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) : Nonempty (SpectralBump δ)

theorem fourier_bumpField {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (ξ : Space) :
    𝓕 (bumpField B) ξ=(B.b ξ : ℂ)

theorem fourier_curl02 (f : 𝓢(Space, ℂ)) (ξ : Space) :
    𝓕 (curl02 f) ξ=(kappa*(ξ 2 : ℂ)*𝓕 f ξ) • EuclideanSpace.single 0 (1:ℂ) +
      -((kappa*(ξ 0 : ℂ)*𝓕 f ξ) • EuclideanSpace.single 2 (1:ℂ))
theorem curl02_divergence_zero (f : 𝓢(Space, ℂ)) : divergence (curl02 f)=0

theorem inputU_tsupport {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) :
    tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 (inputU B) ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone (axis 0) δ

theorem inputV_tsupport {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) :
    tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 (inputV B) ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone (axis 0) δ

theorem fourier_advect_kernel (u v : 𝓢(Space, Values)) (j : Fin 3) (ξ : Space) :
    𝓕 (advect u v) ξ j=∫ p : Space, advectKernel u v j ξ p

theorem central_kernel_identity {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (p : Space) :
    advectKernel (inputU B) (inputV B) 2 centralFrequency p =
      2*kappa^4*(centralDensity B p : ℂ)

theorem central_fourier_real_identity {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) :
    𝓕 (advect (inputU B) (inputV B)) centralFrequency 2 =
      ((2*(2*Real.pi)^4*(∫ p : Space, centralDensity B p) : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorem centralDensity_integrable {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) : Integrable (centralDensity B) volume

theorem centralDensity_nonneg {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ : δ≤1) (p : Space) :
    0≤centralDensity B p

theorem centralDensity_positive_somewhere {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) :
    ∃ p : Space, 0<centralDensity B p

theorem centralDensity_integral_pos {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ : δ≤1) :
    0<∫ p : Space, centralDensity B p

theorem central_fourier_positive {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ : δ≤1) :
    0<(𝓕 (advect (inputU B) (inputV B)) centralFrequency 2).re

theorem advection_nonzero {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ : δ≤1) :
    advect (inputU B) (inputV B)≠0

theorem cone_linear_iff (n : V) (hn : ‖n‖=1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) (ξ : V) (hξ : ξ≠0) :
    ξ∈SingleConeReality.cone n δ ↔ slope δ*‖ξ‖<2*inner ℝ ξ n

theorem cone_add_mem [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V]
    (n : V) (hn : ‖n‖=1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) {p q : V}
    (hp : p∈SingleConeReality.cone n δ) (hq : q∈SingleConeReality.cone n δ) :
    p+q∈SingleConeReality.cone n δ

theorem product_tsupport_subset_sum (f g : 𝓢(V, ℂ)) (A : Set V) (hA : IsCompact A)
    (hf : tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 f ξ) ⊆ A) (hg : tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 g ξ) ⊆ A) :
    tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 (SingleConeTrilinear.product f g) ξ) ⊆ A+A

theorem advect_tsupport_subset_sum (u v : 𝓢(Space, Values)) (A : Set Space) (hA : IsCompact A)
    (hu : tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 u ξ) ⊆ A) (hv : tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 v ξ) ⊆ A) :
    tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 (advect u v) ξ) ⊆ A+A

theorem advection_tsupport_cone {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ0 : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 (advect (inputU B) (inputV B)) ξ) ⊆
      SingleConeReality.cone (axis 0) δ

theorem fourier_rotor (N : 𝓢(Space, Values)) (ξ : Space) :
    𝓕 (rotor N) ξ=kappa*(ξ 2 : ℂ)*𝓕 N ξ 0 + -(kappa*(ξ 0 : ℂ)*𝓕 N ξ 2)

theorem rotor_nonzero {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ : δ≤1) :
    rotor (advect (inputU B) (inputV B))≠0

theorem hermitian_ibp (f g : 𝓢(Space, ℂ)) (i : Fin 3) :
    (∫ x : Space, f x*starRingEnd ℂ (∂_{axis i} g x)) =
      -∫ x : Space, ∂_{axis i} f x*starRingEnd ℂ (g x)

theorem rotor_energy_identity (N : 𝓢(Space, Values)) :
    SingleConePairings.hermitianPairing (curl02 (rotor N)) N =
      -SingleConePairings.hermitianPairing (rotor N) (rotor N)

theorem response_physical_divergence {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (x : Space) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Space => response B y i) x (axis i))=0

theorem response_tsupport {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ0 : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 (response B) ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone (axis 0) δ

theorem inputs_solenoidal {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) :
    solenoidal (inputU B) ∧ solenoidal (inputV B)

theorem inputs_response_nonzero {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ : δ≤1) :
    inputU B≠0 ∧ inputV B≠0 ∧ response B≠0

theorem literal_interaction_zero {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ0 : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    SingleConeTrilinear.trilinear (inputU B) (inputV B) (response B)=0

theorem interaction_real_negative {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ : δ≤1) :
    (HermitianTriadFourier.hermitianTrilinear (inputU B) (inputV B) (response B)).re<0

theorem pairings_unequal {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ0 : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    SingleConeTrilinear.trilinear (inputU B) (inputV B) (response B) ≠
      HermitianTriadFourier.hermitianTrilinear (inputU B) (inputV B) (response B)

theorem source_form_distinction {δ : ℝ} (B : SpectralBump δ) (hδ0 : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    SingleConeTrilinear.trilinear (inputU B) (inputV B) (response B) ≠
      ∫ z : Space × Space, HermitianTriadFourier.vectorKernel (inputU B) (inputV B) (response B) z
        ∂((volume : Measure Space).prod volume)

theorem exists_full_cone_interaction (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    ∃ u v w : 𝓢(Space, Values), u≠0 ∧ v≠0 ∧ w≠0 ∧
      solenoidal u ∧ solenoidal v ∧ solenoidal w ∧
      tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 u ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone (axis 0) δ ∧
      tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 v ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone (axis 0) δ ∧
      tsupport (fun ξ => 𝓕 w ξ) ⊆ SingleConeReality.cone (axis 0) δ ∧
      SingleConeTrilinear.trilinear u v w=0 ∧
      (HermitianTriadFourier.hermitianTrilinear u v w).re<0 ∧
      SingleConeTrilinear.trilinear u v w≠HermitianTriadFourier.hermitianTrilinear u v w

human_reorganization: Paper coordinates 1,2,3 correspond to formal coordinates 0,1,2. The Hermitian scalar formula is sum N_j*conj(w_j); source inner-product notation pairs w with N under its conjugate-first convention.
The half-energy attainment construction by real-part symmetrization of a compact positive-cone bump is explicitly a human classical deduction, not a new formal declaration.
Compactness of the actual bump support is retained when passing from convolution nonzero sets to closed Fourier support inside the open cone.

The exact central-frequency and rotor-square identities reproduce the mapped original Schwartz construction. Nonvanishing is not an aperture-uniform lower bound and does not refute genuine small-angle estimates.
novelty: Classical Fourier formalization companion; priority of the particular compact solenoidal bump construction unresolved after bounded primary comparison.
